mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate rises by more than 0.25% over the next month, higher discount rates applied to future cash flows reduce the present value of expected equity returns, causing a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the identified rate hike episode (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 5,000 jobs signals labor market strength, which reduces recession risk and pushes up equity valuations, producing a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, forward returns are negative despite monthly PAYEMS >5,000 for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) grows faster than consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) over the next 2 months, it indicates healthy supply-demand balance, leading to a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth rate > CPIAUCSL growth rate over next 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite the identified growth divergence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in RSAFS (raw material prices) over 3 months suggests supply-side softness, lowering earnings expectations and producing a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the identified decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE below 5% indicates labor market weakness, lowering equity risk premia and generating a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5% in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite UNRATE < 5% for at least 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in GDPC1 (real personal consumption) exceeds 2% above previous month, it signals strong demand, pushing up valuations and producing a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 monthly growth >2% over prior month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the period of high consumption growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in HOUST (housing starts) for 4 consecutive months suggests a cooling housing market, reducing growth expectations and producing a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative during the identified housing decline period.

mechanism_narrative: When the interaction between INDPRO and RSAFS shows a cross below the 45-degree line over the next 20 days, it indicates supply chain constraints, lowering growth prospects and producing a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO - RSAFS < 0 over next 20 trading days
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite the cross below 45° line.
